answer: Your ex has to sign the sale documents like any co-owner, unless your divorce decree awards the car to you. In that case, bring a certified copy of the decree and you won't need their signature. If they do need to sign and can't come to the appointment, they can sign power of attorney form NW-POA-2 electronically, with no notary. In Georgia, though, a power of attorney has to be notarized. Also, if the names on the title are joined by 'or' instead of 'and', only one owner needs to sign. Because your ID doesn't match the title, bring the document that shows your name change, such as your divorce decree, and sign the name change affidavit (form NW-NMC-1) at the appointment.
